title: TR-SSQP: A Trust-Region Method for Constrained Stochastic Optimization under Heavy-Tailed Noise
summary: We consider stochastic nonlinear optimization problems with deterministic equality constraints. While unconstrained stochastic optimization is well understood, the interplay between optimality and feasibility in the constrained setting poses significant challenges. Moreover, existing theoretical guarantees for constrained stochastic methods predominantly rely on bounded-variance assumptions, leaving the heavy-tailed noise regime largely unexplored. To address this gap, we propose a novel trust-region method within the stochastic sequential quadratic programming framework, termed TR-SSQP. Our…
